experiences.title: Anbetec Tecnologia
experiences.period: From Feb. 2025 to the present day
experiences.markdownContent:
- **Fullstack Developer**
- Designed and developed an end-to-end multi-tenant billing automation engine for the corporate platform, structured in a microservices architecture with NestJS, Next.js, and PostgreSQL.
- Architected the asynchronous dispatch pipeline with AWS SQS FIFO and multichannel processing (Email via AWS SES and WhatsApp), ensuring tenant isolation, idempotency, and charge deduplication via Redis and TypeORM.
- Developed the management interface and public payment route using Next.js and MUI X DataGrid Premium, integrating secure links with JWT tokens and real-time customer interaction tracking.
- Led the standardization of company forms and frontend architecture, creating a centralized reusable component library and strict validation with Zod and React Hook Form, boosting team productivity.
